name: bonsai
description: Grows your agent config as you work, and prunes it before it rots.

retrospective.title: Observe sessions automatically
retrospective.description: After a session ends, run a cheap Haiku pass over the transcript to spot patterns worth codifying. Runs detached — never blocks you. Turn this off to make bonsai fully manual (/bonsai:promote still works).

daily_limit.title: Max retrospectives per day
daily_limit.description: Cost ceiling. Sessions beyond this are skipped, not queued.

retrospective_model.title: Model for observation
retrospective_model.description: Model used for the detached retrospective pass. Haiku is sufficient; raise it only if observations come back low-quality.

auto_accept_low_risk.title: Auto-accept low-risk artifacts (express mode only)
auto_accept_low_risk.description: Let bonsai apply path-scoped rules and memory topic files without review. Root CLAUDE.md, hooks, and permissions always require review regardless of this setting.
